propositions: Standalone completion-verifier runs must record their result on the ticket for later close-time reuse at the same ref
A new producer function record_completion_verdict emits COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecars and signs reusable op-certs for attested PASS verdicts pinned to verified_at_sha
rebar verify-completion CLI records by default with --no-sign opt-out, reporting what was recorded
MCP verify_completion tool records unless server is read-only, with outcome on result.record field
Standalone attested PASS verdicts are signed and reused by later same-ref close operations without invoking the verifier provider again
